messages:
Maya Patel: ok team — quick sync: launching a small PLG experiment next week that ties launch posts + webinar invite + free credits + prompt templates. goal = move new signups to first successful completion (run a prompt) within 24h. thoughts?

Sam Ortiz: sounds good. what size cohort are we targeting for the test?

Maya Patel: 2k MQLs routed over 7 days, holdback 20% (control). cohort pulled from inbound demo requests + webinar signups.

Priya Nair: I can own the webinar invite creative and timing. prefer Wed 11am PT — integrates with our existing demo cadence. will we gate credits on attendance or first-run?

Marco Silva: recommend gating on first-run. give 50 free tokens on signup, then additional 200 on first-run completion. routing-wise: send header utm=plg_launch_v1 to all paid ads + organic launch posts. holdback group gets the tokens but NO prompt templates or onboarding nudge.

Lena Zhang: tagging tracking — please use the canonical UTM pattern. snippet for tracking:

```
utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=plg_prompt_v1&utm_content={variant}
```

Also add header X-Experiment-ID: plg_prompt_holdback_2026. I’ll wire events to Heap and our activation funnel dashboard.

Jules Carter: experiment framework: A/B with three arms: full (posts + webinar + templates + nudges), tokens-only (posts + tokens, no templates/nudge), control (tokens, no templates, delayed nudge). metric: % of users who run a prompt within 24h and median tokens consumed. power calc says 2k gives ~80% power to detect a 4% lift.

Sam Ortiz: copy ask — can I get 3 headline variants for the launch post? we should test 'free credits' vs 'ready-to-use prompts' vs 'webinar invite'.

Maya Patel: yes. Sam, can you run 3 variants and drop into the doc by EOD Fri? Priya — I want the webinar RSVP flow to include a one-click 'add starter prompts' checkbox so we can track intent.

Priya Nair: adding. also creating a short confirmation email with CTA to run 1 of 3 starter prompts (we'll randomize which template they see).

Marco Silva: routing detail: prioritize demo inbound > webinar RSVPs > organic signup. if capacity spikes, fallback to queued email with 'starter prompt pack' + on-demand webinar recording.

Lena Zhang: will set up two funnels in the dashboard and tag each event: signup, token-awarded, prompt-rendered, prompt-submitted. event names: signup_v2, award_tokens, prompt_render, prompt_submit.

Jules Carter: can ops add a telemetry flag so we can quickly disable nudges if it causes churn? safety first.

Maya Patel: good call — @deploy-bot can we gate nudge rollout behind feature-flag "plg_prompt_nudge_v1" and schedule 100% rollout 48h after launch if no major regressions?

deploy-bot: feature-flag 'plg_prompt_nudge_v1' created. rollout schedule: 0% -> 25% (T+6h) -> 50% (T+12h) -> 100% (T+48h) with automated rollback on error-rate > 2% for 15m.

Sam Ortiz: sweet. I'll post 3 copy options here by EOD and mock screenshots for the starter prompts.

Priya Nair: calendar invite for Wed 11am PT created: https://cal.com/redwood/plg-launch-webinar — RSVP link will include utm and exp param.

Maya Patel: amazing. next steps: Sam copy, Priya webinar flow, Lena tracking, Marco routing + token ops, Jules experiment spec doc. sync Wed AM for final go/no-go. :rocket:
